events.name: Internal Communications Failure

bits.0xffff: CSB not receive any CAN data

events.desc_en:
Error code:
0x01: MCU is not communicating.
0x02: UPM 1 is not communicating.
0x04: UPM 2 is not communicating.
0x08: UPM 3 is not communicating.
0x10: UPM 4 is not communicating.
0x20:
…
0x800: UPM11 is not communicating.
0xffff: CSB not receive any CAN data
The MCU checks for any incoming packet from MCU or UPM. If one is not received
within 4 seconds, an Internal Communication alarm is raised.
events.desc_fr: Aucun paquet reçu de la MCU ou d'un UPM depuis 4 s (inhibée 30 s après la mise sous tension).
events.manual_note: Type tronqué dans l'extraction : 'Alarm Level 14 Service'.

events.desc_en: No error code. The capacitor or fan needs to be replaced.
events.desc_fr: Condensateurs et ventilateurs à remplacer (date de rappel EEPROM dépassée).

events.name: Preventive Maintenance Reminder Set
events.desc_en:
Error code:
1 = Set automatically at startup.
2 = Updated using the ATE command.
3 = Reminder date manually updated.
4 = Disabled from the HMI.
events.desc_fr: Rappel de maintenance préventive défini (1 = auto au démarrage, 2 = commande ATE, 3 = date modifiée manuellement, 4 = désactivé depuis le HMI).

events.name: Battery Replacement Reminder Set
events.desc_en:
Error code:
1 = Set automatically at startup.
2 = Updated using the ATE command.
3 = Reminder date manually updated.
4 = Disabled from the HMI.
events.desc_fr: Rappel de remplacement batterie défini (1 = auto au démarrage, 2 = commande ATE, 3 = date modifiée manuellement, 4 = désactivé depuis le HMI).

events.name: Capacitor / Fan Replacement Reminder Set
events.desc_en:
Error code:
1 = Set automatically at startup.
2 = Updated using the ATE command.
3 = Reminder date manually updated.
4 = Disabled from the HMI.
events.desc_fr: Rappel de remplacement condensateurs/ventilateurs défini (1 = auto au démarrage, 2 = commande ATE, 3 = date modifiée manuellement, 4 = désactivé depuis le HMI).

events.name: Inverter AC Under Voltage
events.desc_en:
No error code.
Inverter voltage is below programmed limits on any phase. Used to as an inverter self
test when the inverter starts up in Bypass standby state before going online.
Inverter starts up.
• If there is inverter UV alarm then the inverter stays in bypass and the UV alarm
appears in the history queue.
• If the inverter is in online state it no action is taken for this alarm.
events.desc_fr: Tension onduleur sous les limites programmées sur une phase.

events.name: Bypass AC Over Voltage
events.desc_en:
No error code.
Bypass voltage is above programmed limits on any phase. Transfer to bypass is not
allowed. If UPS is on bypass, UPS will forward transfer to inverter if possible.
events.desc_fr: Tension bypass trop haute : transfert vers bypass interdit.

events.name: Bypass AC Under Voltage
events.desc_en:
No error code.
Bypass voltage is below programmed limits on any phase. Transfer to bypass is not
allowed. If UPS is on bypass, UPS will forward transfer to inverter if possible.
events.desc_fr: Tension bypass trop basse : transfert vers bypass interdit.

events.name: Bypass Under/Over Frequency
events.desc_en:
No error code.
Bypass frequency is above or below programmed limits. Transfer to bypass is not
allowed. If UPS is on bypass, UPS will forward transfer to inverter if possible.
events.desc_fr: Fréquence bypass hors limites.

events.name: Input AC Over Voltage
events.desc_en:
No error code.
Input voltage is above programmed limits on any phase. Rectifier operation is not
possible, transfer to battery if battery is available.
events.desc_fr: Tension d'entrée au-dessus des limites. Le redresseur est désactivé et l'UPM passe sur batterie si elle est disponible.

events.name: Input AC Under Voltage
events.desc_en:
No error code.
Input voltage is below programmed limits on any phase. Rectifier operation may not be
possible, depending on the load. UPS will run on rectifier, rectifier + battery, or battery,
depending on load power requirements. Battery charging may be disabled.
events.desc_fr: Tension d'entrée sous les limites. Fonctionnement redresseur, redresseur+batterie ou batterie selon la charge ; charge batterie possiblement coupée.

events.name: Input Under / Over Frequency
events.desc_en:
No error code.
Input frequency is above or below programmed limits. For information only, no UPS
response.
events.desc_fr: Fréquence d'entrée hors limites.

events.name: Output AC Over Voltage

values.1xxx: Output voltage Sd has been detected abnormal (fast detection)

events.desc_en:
For 3:3 system:
• 2000: phase B RMS OV
• 4000: phase C RMS OV
• 1xxx: Output voltage Sd has been detected abnormal (fast detection)
For 3:1 and 1:1 systems:
• 1000: RMS OV
events.desc_fr: Tension de sortie au-dessus des limites (mesure interne de l'UPM). En monobloc, le code précise la phase ou la détection rapide.

events.name: Output AC Under Voltage
events.desc_en:
For 3:3 system:
2000: phase B RMS UV
4000: phase C RMS UV
• 2000: phase B RMS OV
• 4000: phase C RMS OV
• xxxx: Output voltage Sd has been detected abnormal (fast detection)
For 3:1 system:
• 1000: RMS OV
events.desc_fr: Tension de sortie sous les limites (mesure interne de l'UPM). En monobloc, le code précise la phase ou la détection rapide.

events.name: Output Under / Over Frequency (Not Used)
events.timing: Not yet | Not yet | Not yet | All
events.desc_en: No error code.
events.desc_fr: Événement non utilisé (non encore supporté).

events.name: Remote Emergency Power Off
events.desc_en: No error code. Remote EPO activated. Converters are immediately turned off, load off.
events.desc_fr: EPO distant : convertisseurs et charge coupés immédiatement.

events.name: Inverter Over Temperature
events.desc_en: No error code. Inverter temperature sensor reading is too high, reaching warning level.
events.desc_fr: Température onduleur trop haute (niveau d'avertissement, aucune action automatique).

events.name: OverLoad Level1
events.desc_en:
For 3:3 system:
• 0x01: Phase A overload
• 0x02: Phase B overload
• 0x04: Phase C overload
For 3:1, 1:1 systems:
• 0x01: Phase A overload
• 0x02: Phase B overload
• 0x04: Phase C overload
• 0x08: Sum overload
Load power or VA above rating. See Behavioral document for overload response.
events.desc_fr: Charge au-dessus du niveau de surcharge 1 (monobloc). Bits : 1 = phase A, 2 = phase B, 4 = phase C, 8 = somme (systèmes 3:1 et 1:1).

events.name: Rectifier Input Over Current
events.desc_en:
• 0x0001: phase A over current
• 0x0010: phase B over current
• 0x0100: phase C over current
Rectifier hardware current limit latch set for a defined number of continuous line cycles.
Set rectifier off, transfer to battery.
events.desc_fr: Limite de courant matérielle du redresseur atteinte plusieurs cycles : redresseur coupé, transfert sur batterie.

events.name: Inverter Output Over Current
events.desc_en:
• 0x0001: phase A over current
• 0x0010: phase B over current
• 0x0100: phase C over current
Inverter hardware current limit latch set for a defined number of continuous line cycles.
Set inverter off, transfer to bypass if possible.
events.desc_fr: Limite de courant de sortie onduleur atteinte : onduleur coupé, transfert sur bypass si possible.

events.name: DC Link Over Voltage
events.desc_en:
Error code:
0x01: Positive BUS Over Voltage
0x02: negative BUS Over Voltage
events.desc_fr: Tension du bus DC trop haute : convertisseurs coupés, transfert sur bypass si possible.

events.name: DC Link Under Voltage
events.desc_en: No error code.
events.desc_fr: Tension du bus DC trop basse : convertisseurs coupés immédiatement.

events.name: Static Switch Failed
events.desc_en:
No error code.
Communication with SSW PIC processor is lost, bypass status is unknown. Bypass
transfer not allowed.
events.desc_fr: Communication avec le processeur PIC du STS perdue : état du bypass inconnu, transfert vers bypass interdit.

events.name: Battery Current Over Limit
events.desc_en:
No error code.
Battery hardware current limit latch set for a defined number of continuous line cycles.
Set charger/boost off.
events.desc_fr: Limite de courant batterie atteinte : chargeur/boost coupé.

events.name: EEPROM Checksum Failed
events.desc_en:
Bit field, bit is set corresponding to the section that failed the checksum test.
0x0001 = section 0 failed
0x0002 = section 1 failed
Interface board EEPROM checksum failure at initialization. Startup not allowed.
events.desc_fr: Échec de checksum EEPROM de la carte interface à l'initialisation ; démarrage interdit (un bit par section).

events.name: Shutdown Imminent
events.timing: Not yet | Not yet | Not yet | All
events.desc_en:
No error code.
Load power off warning. UPS is about to shutdown the load. Battery UV limit is reached
and low battery shutdown counter started.
events.desc_fr: Avertissement de coupure imminente de la charge (limite batterie atteinte, ou surcharge sans bypass disponible).

events.name: Low Battery Warning
events.desc_en:
No error code.
The battery voltage is below the low battery alarm level and UPS is on battery mode.
events.desc_fr: Tension batterie sous le niveau d'alarme batterie faible.

events.name: ABM Installed
events.desc_en: No error code.
events.desc_fr: ABM (gestion avancée de batterie) installé.

events.name: Utility Not Available
events.desc_en:
Utility has failed. Lost phase lock with utility or utility voltage has fallen below 47% of
nominal voltage. Unit goes to battery mode when active.
events.desc_fr: Réseau perdu (perte de verrouillage de phase ou tension < 50 % du nominal) : passage sur batterie.

events.name: Battery DC Over Voltage
events.desc_en:
No error code.
A set of battery voltage sensors detects a battery voltage higher than 2.45 VPC longer
than the alarm appears in the history queue. If the voltage goes above 2.45 VPC, the
charger is shut off. An active time alarm appears in the history queue and the unit will
disconnect the battery.
events.desc_fr: Tension batterie > 2,45 V/élément : chargeur coupé, batterie déconnectée après 60 s.

events.name: ABM Enable
events.desc_en:
No error code.
The ABM is enabled and can be activated
events.desc_fr: ABM activé et activable.

events.name: To Bypass Command
events.desc_en:
No error code.
UPM received an external command to transfer to bypass
events.desc_fr: Commande « To Bypass Command » reçue.

events.name: Bypass Not Available

bits.0x04: No Sync to bypass or BypassNotInstalled

events.desc_en:
Error code:
• 0x01: bypass phase lock fail
• 0x02:bypass voltage DQ loss
• 0x04: No Sync to bypass or BypassNotInstalled
This alarm is raised if any of these alarms are raised: Bypass phase rotation alarm,
Bypass under voltage alarm, Bypass over voltage alarm, Bypass under/over frequency
alarm or Static switch failure alarm AND the backfeed relay is closed.
events.desc_fr: Bypass indisponible (rotation, tension, fréquence ou défaut interrupteur statique) alors que le relais anti-retour est fermé.

events.name: Rectifier Phase Rotation
events.desc_en:
No error code.
Rectifier input phase rotation is reversed.
events.desc_fr: Ordre des phases d'entrée redresseur inversé.

events.name: Bypass Phase Rotation
events.desc_en:
No error code.
Bypass phases are rotated. Transfer to bypass is not allowed.
events.desc_fr: Ordre des phases bypass inversé : transfert vers bypass interdit.

events.name: UPM Control Power On
events.timing: N/A set at | N/A | N/A | When
events.desc_en:
No error code.
This status is logged after the initialization is complete.
events.desc_fr: Statut journalisé à la fin de l'initialisation du module.

events.name: Inverter On
events.desc_en:
No error code.
This event is logged when inverter is started or stopped.
events.desc_fr: Journalisé au démarrage ou à l'arrêt de l'onduleur.

events.name: Charger On
events.desc_en:
No error code.
The event is logged when charger is started or stopped.
events.desc_fr: Journalisé au démarrage ou à l'arrêt du chargeur.

events.name: Internal MBS Active
events.desc_en:
No error code.
Internal MBS is installed and activated.
events.desc_fr: Bypass de maintenance (MBS) interne installé et activé.

events.name: Service Battery

bits.0x0001: Voltage dropped too much in rest mode (opportunity charge)
bits.0x0100: Battery positive is faulted to ground
bits.0x1000: Battery negative is faulted to ground

events.desc_en:
Battery needs to be serviced.
Error code:
• 0x0001 = Voltage dropped too much in rest mode (opportunity charge)
• 0x0010 = Battery is connected backwards
• 0x0100 = Battery positive is faulted to ground
• 0x1000 = Battery negative is faulted to ground
events.desc_fr: La batterie nécessite une intervention.

events.name: OverLoad Level2
events.desc_en:
Error code:
For 3:3 system:
• 0x01: Phase A overload
• 0x02: Phase B overload
• 0x04: Phase C overload
For 3:1, 1:1 systems:
• 0x01: Phase A overload
• 0x02: Phase B overload
• 0x04: Phase C overload
• 0x08: Sum overload
events.desc_fr: Charge au-dessus du niveau de surcharge 2 (monobloc). Bits : 1 = phase A, 2 = phase B, 4 = phase C, 8 = somme (systèmes 3:1 et 1:1).

events.name: OverLoad Level3
events.desc_en:
Error code:
For 3:3 system:
• 0x01: Phase A overload
• 0x02: Phase B overload
• 0x04: Phase C overload
For 3:1, 1:1 systems:
• 0x01: Phase A overload
• 0x02: Phase B overload
• 0x04: Phase C overload
• 0x08: Sum overload
Output power/VA exceeds level 3 limit.
events.desc_fr: Charge au-dessus du niveau de surcharge 3 (monobloc). Bits : 1 = phase A, 2 = phase B, 4 = phase C, 8 = somme.

events.name: OverLoad Level4
events.desc_en:
Error code:
None: Single phase system overload
• 0x01: Phase A overload
• 0x02: Phase B overload
• 0x04: Phase C overload
For 3:1, 1:1 systems:
• 0x01: Phase A overload
• 0x02: Phase B overload
• 0x04: Phase C overload
• 0x08: Sum overload
Output power/VA exceeds level 4 limit.
events.desc_fr: Charge au-dessus du niveau de surcharge 4 (monobloc). Bits : 1 = phase A, 2 = phase B, 4 = phase C, 8 = somme.

events.name: UPS On Battery
events.desc_en:
No error code.
Load is powered from the battery. This status is suppressed during the battery test.
events.desc_fr: La charge est alimentée par la batterie.

events.name: UPS On Bypass
events.desc_en:
No error code.
Load is powered from bypass. The status is suppressed in ESS mode.
events.desc_fr: La charge est alimentée par le bypass.

events.name: Load Power Off
events.desc_en: No error code.
events.desc_fr: La charge a été coupée de façon anormale (pas sur commande, EPO ou batterie basse).

events.name: Backfeed Switchgear Closed
events.desc_en:
No error code.
This event is used by the CSB to determine if the inverter relay is closed or open. It does
not impact the UPM functionality.
events.desc_fr: Le relais ou contacteur anti-retour est fermé.

events.name: UPS Off Command
events.desc_en: No error code.
events.desc_fr: Commande « UPS Off Command » reçue.

events.name: Low Battery Shutdown
events.desc_en:
No error code.
Battery shutdown 2 minute timer has started.
events.desc_fr: Tension batterie sous la limite EEPROM : charge coupée après 3 s.

events.name: Software Incompatible
events.desc_en:
Error code:
0x001x = Interface board ID is incorrect for this firmware. Lowest 4 bits show the
incorrect ID read from HW.
0x0020 = Incompatible PLD version
0x003x= Incompatible Interface BoardRevID, x is ID.
events.desc_fr: Firmware ou PLD incompatible (ID de carte interface, version PLD).

events.name: Battery Test Failed

bits.0x1: battery voltage too low during battery test
bits.0x10: battery voltage < battery UV shutdown limit

events.desc_en:
Error code:
0x1: battery voltage too low during battery test
0x2: battery over current during.
0x10: battery voltage < battery UV shutdown limit
0x11: Battery overtemperture
events.desc_fr: Un test batterie a échoué : tension passée sous la limite.

events.name: Fuse Failed
events.desc_en:
Error code:
Only For system 3:3 or system 3:1
0x0001 = Rectifier Phase A
0x0002 = Rectifier Phase B
0x0004 = Rectifier Phase C
One or more fuses detected open.
events.desc_fr: Un ou plusieurs fusibles redresseur détectés ouverts (systèmes 3:3 et 3:1 seulement ; bit 1/2/4 = phase A/B/C).

events.name: Fan Failed
events.desc_en:
Error code:
0x01 = Fan 1 failed.
0x02 = StsFan failed.
A rotor is locked in one or more fans.
events.desc_fr: Rotor bloqué détecté sur un ou plusieurs ventilateurs.

events.name: Site Wiring Fault
events.desc_en:
Error code:
0x01: Neutral Fault
0x02: Ground Fault
events.desc_fr: Tension neutre-terre excessive (défaut de câblage du site).
events.manual_note: Libellé 'All Level 10 User' dans le manuel, lu comme alarme niveau 10 utilisateur.

events.name: Backfeed Switchgear Failed

values.13: phA + phC fail to open… etc
values.46: phA + phC fail to close… etc
values.1000: phA or phB or phC fail to open
values.2000: phA or phB or phC fail to close

events.desc_en:
Error code:
For 3:1 or 1:1:
• 1 = phA fail to open
• 2 = phB fail to open
• 3 = phC fail to open
• 12 = phA + phB fail to open
• 13 = phA + phC fail to open… etc
• 4 = phA fail to close
• 5 = phB fail to close
• 6 = phC fail to close
• 45 = phA + phB fail to close
• 46 = phA + phC fail to close… etc
For 3:3:
• 1000 = phA or phB or phC fail to open
• 2000 = phA or phB or phC fail to close
events.desc_fr: Défaut du ou des relais/contacteurs anti-retour.

events.name: Batteries disconnected
events.desc_en: No error code. The batteries are not connected.
events.desc_fr: Batteries non connectées, aucune tension batterie.

events.name: Ambient Over Temperature
events.desc_en: No error code. The ambient temperature is over the limit.
events.desc_fr: Température ambiante de l'UPM trop haute.

events.name: UPM Selective Trip
events.desc_en: No error. Selective trip of parallel UPM has occurred.
events.desc_fr: Déclenchement sélectif d'un UPM en parallèle : défaut onduleur critique, module retiré du système.

events.name: Output Voltage Abnormal

values.1: No voltage on output, other unit on bypass
values.2: No voltage on output, other unit online
values.3: Voltage on output, other units are not on
values.4: Voltage on inverter, inverter relay open, inverter off

events.desc_en:
Error code:
1= No voltage on output, other unit on bypass
2= No voltage on output, other unit online
3= Voltage on output, other units are not on
4= Voltage on inverter, inverter relay open, inverter off
events.desc_fr: Tension de sortie anormale au démarrage : relais collé, SCR en court-circuit ou problème de communication parallèle.

events.name: Rectifier Over Temperature
events.desc_en:
No error code.
Rectifier / boost temperature sensor reading is too high. Warning level.
events.desc_fr: Température redresseur/boost trop haute (avertissement).

events.name: Configuration Error

bits.0x01: Parallel UPM or UPS number is invalid.
bits.0x02: EE map revision is too high (firmware downgrade).
bits.0x08: Observed bypass PIC when not expected.
bits.0x10: Observed PCAN packets in a non-parallel configuration.
bits.0x20: Private section values mismatch between boards.
bits.0x80: EEPROM has been reset and verification is required.
bits.0x100: Hardware revision incompatible with current configuration
bits.0x200: System invalid, it is not a available system type
bits.0x400: Check system type fail, refer to Check System Type Failed
bits.0x800: Decryption failed when communicate with SHA204
bits.0x1000: the dead band configure failed for the system
bits.0x2000: control board HW version is not correct

events.desc_en:
Several error conditions can be active at the same time.
0x01 = Parallel UPM or UPS number is invalid.
0x02 = EE map revision is too high (firmware downgrade).
0x04 = PLD version fail.
0x08 = Observed bypass PIC when not expected.
0x10 = Observed PCAN packets in a non-parallel configuration.
0x20 = Private section values mismatch between boards.
0x40 = Field service is required.
0x80 = EEPROM has been reset and verification is required.
0x100 = Hardware revision incompatible with current configuration
0x200 = System invalid, it is not a available system type
0x400 = Check system type fail, refer to Check System Type Failed
0x800 = Decryption failed when communicate with SHA204
0x1000 = the dead band configure failed for the system
0x2000 = control board HW version is not correct
0x4000 = battery cells setup required
events.desc_fr: Erreur de configuration. Plusieurs conditions peuvent être actives en même temps (code = somme de bits).

events.name: System Not Redundant
events.desc_en:
No error code.
Parallel system configured for redundancy is operating in capacity mode.
events.desc_fr: Système parallèle configuré en redondance fonctionnant en mode capacité.

events.name: ESS Mode On

bits.0x02: inverter is not phase locked to bypass

events.desc_en:
Error code:
0x02 = inverter is not phase locked to bypass
0x04 = bypass not available
events.desc_fr: Le mode ESS est actif.

events.name: UPS System Normal
events.desc_en:
No error code.
This status is activated when the UPS state changes to normal mode.
events.desc_fr: L'UPS est passé en mode normal.

events.name: VMMS Installed
events.desc_en: No error code.
events.desc_fr: VMMS installé.
events.manual_note: Type et niveau absents dans le manuel (statut 'installed').

events.name: PreCharge Failed

values.3: Precharge voltage fail to reach the precharge limit
values.9: Error between voltage of positive and negative is greater than 5V.
values.13: DC bus Can not reach reference voltage
values.16: Rectifier state is not in On_battery or To_battery mode

events.desc_en:
Error code:
2 = Precharge voltage under 25V
3 = Precharge voltage fail to reach the precharge limit
9 = Error between voltage of positive and negative is greater than 5V.
11= Battery shutdown in DC startup
12 = No precharge voltage detected
13 = DC bus Can not reach reference voltage
14 = Precharge the battery cap failed
15 = Battery switch gear closed failed
16 = Rectifier state is not in On_battery or To_battery mode
events.desc_fr: La précharge du bus DC a échoué : l'UPS ne peut pas démarrer.

events.name: Rectifier On/ Off
events.desc_en: No error code.
events.desc_fr: Journalisé à la mise en marche ou à l'arrêt du redresseur.

events.name: UPS On Generator
events.desc_en:
No error code.
UPS is on generator mode.
events.desc_fr: L'UPS fonctionne sur groupe électrogène (entrée de signal configurée "On generator").

events.name: Battery Test In Progress
events.desc_en:
No error code.
UPS is running a battery test.
events.desc_fr: Un test batterie (rapide ou complet) est en cours.

events.name: VMMS Enable
events.desc_en:
No error code.
Set if VMMS is enabled.
events.desc_fr: VMMS activé.

events.name: VMMS active
events.desc_en:
No error code.
Not supported.
events.desc_fr: L'UPS est en mode VMMS.

events.name: ABM State Charging
events.desc_en:
No error code.
ABM charge mode is in charge.
events.desc_fr: Mode ABM : charge.

events.name: ABM State Floating
events.desc_en:
No error code.
ABM charge mode is float.
events.desc_fr: Mode ABM : floating (maintien).

events.name: ABM State Resting
events.desc_en:
No error code.
ABM charge mode is rest.
events.desc_fr: Mode ABM : repos.

events.name: ABM State Reset
events.desc_en:
No error code.
ABM is disabled through user setting.
events.desc_fr: ABM réinitialisé (ou désactivé par réglage utilisateur).

events.name: Output Hot
events.desc_en:
No error code.
CSB determines if the output is energized.
events.desc_fr: Indique à la CSB si la sortie est sous tension ; n'agit que sur l'affichage.

events.name: Bypass Hot
events.desc_en:
No error code.
CSB determines if the bypass input is energized.
events.desc_fr: Indique à la CSB si l'entrée bypass est sous tension ; n'agit que sur l'affichage.

events.name: Battery Discharging
events.desc_en:
No error code.
CSB determines if the battery is discharging.
events.desc_fr: La batterie se décharge ; n'agit que sur l'affichage.

events.name: Inverter Switchgear Closed
events.desc_en:
No error code.
CSB determines if the inverter relay is closed or open.
events.desc_fr: Indique si le relais onduleur est fermé ; sert à l'affichage, sans effet fonctionnel.

events.name: MIS Open / Closed
events.desc_en:
No error code.
Indicates if the Inverter Contactor is closed or open. The status is always false.
events.desc_fr: Indique si le MIS/contacteur onduleur est ouvert ou fermé.

events.name: MIS Installed
events.timing: Always false | Always false | Always false | None
events.desc_en:
No error code.
The status is always false.
events.desc_fr: Indique si un MIS est installé (toujours faux).

events.name: Bypass Installed
events.desc_en: No error code.
events.desc_fr: Indique si le bypass est installé.

events.name: MBS Installed
events.desc_en: No error code.
events.desc_fr: Indique si le bypass de maintenance (MBS) est installé.

events.name: Battery Installed
events.desc_en: No error code.
events.desc_fr: Indique si la batterie est installée.

events.name: External Can Bus Failed
events.desc_en:
Error code:
1 = UPM not responding
events.desc_fr: Défaut du bus CAN externe (1 = UPM ne répond pas).

events.name: Charger Off Command
events.desc_en: No error code.
events.desc_fr: Commande « Charger Off Command » reçue.

events.name: Battery Switchgear Open/ Closed
events.desc_en: No error code.
events.desc_fr: Le relais batterie ou un contacteur interne à l'UPS est ouvert ou fermé.

events.name: ESS Installed
events.desc_en: No error code. The unit has ESS mode installed.
events.desc_fr: Le mode ESS est installé et peut être commandé.

events.name: ESS Enable
events.desc_en: No error code. Set if ESS mode is enabled.
events.desc_fr: Le mode ESS est activé.

events.name: Battery In Common
events.desc_en: No error code. The status is valid only in a parallel system with two or more UPMs.
events.desc_fr: Valable en parallèle (2 UPM ou plus) : vrai si les UPM partagent une batterie commune.

events.name: Too Many Inverter Transfers
events.desc_en:
Error code:
355=ESS Lock
Unit locked on bypass: UPM has emergency transferred on bypass and back 3 times
within a 10 minute time window. The unit will be locked on bypass for 1 hour.
Unit Online: UPM has transferred from ESS mode to Online too many times within a 1
hour period due to some disturbances. ESS mode is disabled for a defined time period.
In the process of startup, if UPM back to shutdown from standby or online 3 time within
10 minutes. The unit will be locked on shutdown for 60 minutes.
events.desc_fr: Trop de transferts onduleur / orage.

events.name: Output Phase Rotation
events.desc_en: No error code.
events.desc_fr: Ordre des phases de sortie inversé.

events.name: Static Switch Short
events.desc_en:
Error code:
1 = phA
2 = phB
3 = phC
12 = phA + phB
13 = phA + phC … etc
Static switch current is too high.
events.desc_fr: Courant trop élevé dans l'interrupteur statique alors qu'il n'est pas commandé.

events.name: Pull Chain
events.desc_en:
No error code.
In an external parallel system, indicates that one or more UPSs have transferred to
bypass in the presence of a CAN bus failure.
events.desc_fr: En parallèle, une ou plusieurs UPS ont transféré sur bypass en présence d'un défaut CAN (pull chain active).

events.name: Check Pull Chain
events.desc_en:
No error code.
Indicates that the pull chain is being pulled low when not on bypass, or that the pull chain
is floating high when on bypass.
events.desc_fr: Pull chain tirée au niveau bas alors qu'une MCU n'est pas sur bypass, ou flottante au niveau haut alors qu'une MCU est sur bypass.

events.name: UPS Normal Command
events.desc_en: No error code.
events.desc_fr: Commande « UPS Normal Command » reçue.

events.name: Rectifier Startup Failed
events.desc_en: No error code.
events.desc_fr: Le redresseur n'a pas démarré.

events.name: Inverter Switchgear Failed
events.desc_en:
Error code:
Under ESS mode:
1 = phA , system 33
2 = phB , system 33
3 = phC , system 33
12 = phA + phB, system 33
13 = phA + phC … etc, system 33
1000= system 31 or system 33
Under others (online/standby/byp) mode:
4 = phA, system 33
5 = phB, system 33
6 = phC, system 33
45 = phA + phB, system 33
46 = phA + phC … etc, system 33
2000= system 31 or system 33
events.desc_fr: Relais onduleur collé (fermé ou ouvert). Effacé sur commande utilisateur.

events.name: Inverter Over Temperature Trip
events.desc_en:
No error code.
Inverter heat sink temperature exceeded the shutdown level, the immediate inverter is
off. Transfer to bypass if possible.
events.desc_fr: Radiateur onduleur au-dessus du seuil d'arrêt : onduleur coupé, transfert bypass si possible.

events.name: Rectifier Over Temperature Trip
events.desc_en:
No error code.
Rectifier/boost heat sink temperature exceeded shutdown level, the immediate inverter
off. Transfer to bypass if possible.
events.desc_fr: Radiateur redresseur/boost au-dessus du seuil d'arrêt.

events.name: Automatic Start Up Pending
events.desc_en: No error code.
events.desc_fr: L'UPS s'est arrêtée sur batterie épuisée ; le redémarrage automatique est en attente du retour du réseau.

events.name: Charger On Command
events.desc_en: No error code.
events.desc_fr: Commande « Charger On Command » reçue.

events.name: Charger Failed

values.1: Charger didn’t get to charge voltage within maximum time in constant current
values.2: Battery bus precharge fail (voltage greater than battery voltage + 10V)
values.4: Battery bus precharge fail (voltage lower than battery voltage -10V)

events.desc_en:
Error code:
• 1 = Charger didn’t get to charge voltage within maximum time in constant current
charge
• 2 = Battery bus precharge fail (voltage greater than battery voltage + 10V)
• 4 = Battery bus precharge fail (voltage lower than battery voltage -10V)
• 8 = Battery over voltage 3 times
events.desc_fr: Défaut du chargeur.

events.name: Battery Switchgear Failed
events.desc_en:
Error code:
1 = Battery relay failed to open
2 =Battery relay failed to close
events.desc_fr: Défaut du relais batterie.

events.name: Output Overload Trip
events.desc_en: No error code.
events.desc_fr: Déclenchement sur surcharge de sortie.

events.name: 5V Power Supply Failed
events.desc_en: No error code.
events.desc_fr: Défaut de l'alimentation logique 5 V.

events.name: 24V Power Supply Failed
events.desc_en: No error code.
events.desc_fr: Défaut de l'alimentation logique 24 V.

events.name: Input Sync Out of Range
events.desc_en: No error code.
events.desc_fr: La fréquence d'entrée n'est plus qualifiée pour la synchronisation.

events.name: Inverter Startup Failure

values.1: There is not enough UPS support the load, in standby.
values.2: Didn't receive pull chain within 1s in standby.

events.desc_en:
Error code:
• 1= There is not enough UPS support the load, in standby.
• 2= Didn't receive pull chain within 1s in standby.
• No error code = Inverter has failed to start in bypass standby.
events.desc_fr: L'onduleur n'a pas démarré.

events.name: UPS On ECT Mode

values.1: Exit ECT mode when time is over

events.desc_en:
Error code:
• 1 = Exit ECT mode when time is over
• 2 = Unbalance power
• 4 = Other abnormal condition
events.desc_fr: L'UPS est en mode ECT (1 = temps écoulé, 2 = puissance déséquilibrée, 4 = autre condition anormale).

events.name: I2C Bus Failed
events.desc_en:
Error code:
1 = Module timeout
2 = Arbitration lost
3 = PLD NACK
4 = Receive FIFO overrun
5 = IOExpander NACK
6 = Start condition by another master
7 = Stop condition by another master
events.desc_fr: Problème de bus I2C dans le module.

events.name: Rectifier Switchgear Open
events.desc_en:
No error code.
The unit’s rectifier switchgear is open, the rectifier is off.
events.desc_fr: Appareillage redresseur ouvert : le redresseur est arrêté.

events.name: Easy Capacity Test Command
events.timing: N/A | N/A | Reset Alarm | UPM only
events.desc_en:
No error code.
UPM has received the ECT command.
events.desc_fr: Commande « Easy Capacity Test Command » reçue.

events.name: UPS Exit ECT Process
events.desc_en:
No error code.
UPM has exited the ECT mode in an abnormal manner.
events.desc_fr: Sortie du processus ECT (bits : temporisation, commande annulée, UPM sorti d'ECT, bypass indisponible, charge distante coupée, surcharge, EPO ou surtempérature bypass).

events.name: Parameter Match Failed
events.desc_en:
Error code:
10000 = Number of UPM is incorrect
20000 = Number of UPS is incorrect
0xxxx = xxxx is address of miss match
events.desc_fr: Écart entre paramètres partagés externes : le système ne peut plus passer online (reste online/bypass s'il y est). Corriger l'EEP en écart, puis reset alarmes depuis le HMI.

events.name: System Test
events.desc_en: 2: Performing parallel auto-calibration
events.desc_fr: Test système en cours (2 = auto-calibration parallèle).

events.name: On Maintenance Bypass
events.desc_en: No error code.
events.desc_fr: La charge est sur le bypass de maintenance.

events.name: MOB Open
events.desc_en: No error code.
events.desc_fr: Le disjoncteur de sortie du module (MOB) est ouvert.

events.name: MOB Failure
events.desc_en: No error code.
events.desc_fr: Défaut du disjoncteur de sortie du module (MOB).

events.name: Distributed Parallel System
events.desc_en:
Error code:
CurrentUPSsOnBus
events.desc_fr: Système parallèle distribué.

events.name: System Is Redundant
events.desc_en: No error code.
events.desc_fr: Le système est redondant.

events.name: Inverter Fault
events.desc_en: No error code.
events.desc_fr: Défaut matériel de l'onduleur : signal de défaut du gate driver actif.

events.name: Battery Over Temperature
events.desc_en:
No error code.
Power module temperature sensor reading too high.
events.desc_fr: Température batterie ou convertisseur batterie trop haute.

events.name: Battery Over Temperature Trip
events.desc_en:
No error code.
Power module temperature sensor reading exceeded shutdown level.
events.desc_fr: Arrêt de la batterie sur température trop haute.

events.name: Battery Breaker Failure
events.desc_en: No error code.
events.desc_fr: Défaut du disjoncteur batterie.

events.name: Too Many Battery Transfers
events.desc_en:
No error code.
Unit locked on battery: UPM has transferred on battery and back 3 times within 30
seconds time window. The unit will be locked on battery for 2 minutes.
events.desc_fr: Trop de transferts normal/batterie.

events.name: SPI Bus Failed
events.desc_en: Error code: 1.
events.desc_fr: Problème de bus SPI dans le module.

events.name: Parallel Load Share Error

values.1: Phase A Parallel Load Share Error
values.2: Phase B Parallel Load Share Error
values.4: Phase C Parallel Load Share Error

events.desc_en:
Error code:
Only for system 3:3:
1 = Phase A Parallel Load Share Error
2 = Phase B Parallel Load Share Error
4 = Phase C Parallel Load Share Error
events.desc_fr: Erreur de partage de charge en parallèle (système 3:3 ; 1 = phase A, 2 = phase B, 4 = phase C).

events.name: ESS Not Available

bits.0x0001: ESS Lockout due to three time transfer
bits.0x0020: One or several UPM's requests us to disable ESS
bits.0x0400: Some UPM is in ABM reset state
bits.0x2000: waiting for timer to expire before entering ESS mode
bits.0x8000: P9P100-402 only one charger should be on when going to ESS

events.desc_en:
Error code:
0x0001 = ESS Lockout due to three time transfer
0x0002 = Remote ESS/VMMS Off is active
0x0004 = Battery conditions not ok
0x0008 = Communication failure active
0x0010 = On generator
0x0020 = One or several UPM's requests us to disable ESS
0x0040 = Remote rectifier off active
0x0080 = Overload level 2 or higher
0x0100 = ESS Frequency fault 50 Hz +/- 3.5 Hz
0x0200 = Phase locked to bypass
0x0400 = Some UPM is in ABM reset state
0x0800 = Under Voltage fault
0x1000 = Over Voltage fault
0x2000 = waiting for timer to expire before entering ESS mode
0x4000 = External comm error
0x8000 = P9P100-402 only one charger should be on when going to ESS
events.desc_fr: ESS indisponible (bits : alerte haute, ESS distant off, batterie, communication, groupe, UPM suspendu indisponible, surcharge niveau 2, défaut de fréquence, bypass non verrouillé, tension, temporisation, CAN externe).

events.name: Battery Breaker Open/ Closed
events.desc_en:
Error code:
0x1: Inverter battery breaker open
0x2: External battery breaker open
events.desc_fr: Disjoncteur batterie ouvert (retour contact auxiliaire). Peut être ouvert par l'utilisateur ou par un déclenchement EPO.

events.name: Rectifier Fault
events.desc_en:
No error code.
Activates when the rectifier reports a hardware error.
events.desc_fr: Défaut matériel du redresseur : signal de défaut gate driver actif.

events.name: Leg Load Unbalance
events.desc_en: No error code.
events.desc_fr: Déséquilibre de charge entre les branches (legs).

events.name: Battery Startup Failure
events.desc_en:
Error code:
1= IntBatBreakerFB
2= ExtBatBreakerFB
events.desc_fr: Le convertisseur batterie n'a pas démarré après 3 demandes.

events.name: High Alert
events.desc_en: No error code.
events.desc_fr: Alerte haute ESS active (détection d'orage).

events.name: Exit ESS Mode
events.desc_en:
Error code:
For system 3:3:
• 0x00001= Phase A UV Fault
• 0x00002= Phase B UV Fault
• 0x00004= Phase C UV Fault
For system 3:1 or 1:1:
• 0x00001= UV Fault
• 0x10000=OV Fault
events.desc_fr: Sortie du mode ESS (champ de bits des raisons : surcharge niveau 2, défaut de fréquence, bypass non verrouillé en phase, sous/surtension par phase, UPM online, autre défaut).

events.name: Check System Type Failed
events.desc_en: No error code.
events.desc_fr: Échec de la vérification du type de système (configuration).

events.name: Check Input Type Configuration
events.desc_en:
Error code:
For system 3:1
• 0x1: AB line voltage Vab abnormal
• 0x2: BC line voltage Vbc abnormal
For system 1:1
• 0x08: AB line voltage Vab abnormal
• 0x10: BC line voltage Vbc abnormal
For system 3:3, none
events.desc_fr: Configuration du type d'entrée à vérifier (tension composée AB ou BC anormale).

events.name: Ambient Temperature Changed
events.desc_en: No error code.
events.desc_fr: Température ambiante modifiée ; le code donne la température en °C (complément à deux si négative).

events.name: Check Ambient Temperature
events.desc_en: Threshold Time
events.desc_fr: Température ambiante au-dessus du seuil depuis la durée définie.

events.name: Battery Test Aborted

bits.0x4: rectifier is not normal during battery test

events.desc_en:
Error code:
0x4: rectifier is not normal during battery test
0x8: load percentage < 5%
events.desc_fr: La commande de test batterie n'a pas pu aboutir.
